title: Recommendation Pipeline Pilot — Board F Validation
type: Framework v2 Shadow-Mode Pilot — Read-Only Analysis
purpose: Validate the Recommendation Pipeline spec by tracing 3 historical sessions (S809.1, S809.2, S810) through the full OPEN→CLOSED lifecycle. Demonstrates that Framework v2 recommendations would have converted report-only findings into executable, traceable work — preventing the S809 chain (4 sessions, 60+ agents, 0 writes).

gap_analysis.title: The S809 Gap: Why Recommendations Need to Be First-Class Objects
gap_analysis.description: In the pre-Framework-v2 world, three sequential sessions (S809.1, S809.2, S810) collectively discovered 38 Domain E seeds with identical defect signatures. Each session produced detailed reports recommending remediation (CC audit, 53 empty EW slot fills, 9 DL-013 boilerplate replacements, COSO citation enrichment). But recommendations existed only as static report artifacts — they could not launch work, track execution, or verify closure. The result: 4 sessions, 60+ agents, 0 pack-file writes. Under Framework v2, the same findings produce Recommendation objects that route directly to execution via the lifecycle pipeline.

examples.title: S809.1 → Domain E Certification Scoping — Findings That Could Not Launch
examples.summary: S809.1 was an 8-agent read-only scoping session that audited 38 Domain E certification seeds across Packs C and D. It produced 9 output files with a 4-wave 8-batch remediation plan for S810. Key findings: all 38 seeds carry DL-016 EW rotation offset, 45 of 114 distractor EW slots empty, 5 seeds need CorrectChoice audit, 38/38 Certified and in learner pool yet partially broken. The session recommended: (1) CC audit on 5 seeds, (2) DL-016-aware EW authoring, (3) SOX gap fill. None of these recommendations could be executed — they existed only as report artifacts.

finding.description: All 38 Domain E seeds carry DL-016 ExplanationWrong rotation offset. EW text describes +1 neighbor's choices, not current item's choices. Learners selecting wrong answers see feedback about a completely different topic.
finding.severity: HIGH — learner-safety risk on 38 Certified items

tracing.recommendation_creation: Under Framework v2, Agent H's finding would trigger 4 Recommendation objects (REC-S809-001 through REC-S809-004) in the registry — one for each defect class found. These would transition OPEN→ASSIGNED→IN_PROGRESS→VERIFIED→CLOSED across S810 and S811.
tracing.session_assignment: The S810 batch plan (4 waves, 8 batches) was already designed. Recommendations would be assigned to S810 for EW remediation and S811 for CAQS six-dimension verification.
tracing.work_execution: S810 would execute Batches A-D per the plan: fill 53 empty EW slots, replace 9 DL-013 boilerplate slots, enrich weak ExplanationCorrect fields.
tracing.closure_evidence: S811 would verify: 0 DL-026 empty slots, 0 DL-013 boilerplate, 0 DL-008 regression, all 38 seeds passing CAQS §1.6 six-dimension verification. Closure evidence: S811 verification report with per-QID attestation.

examples.title: S809.2 → Domain E Seed Remediation Readiness — Deeper Findings, Still No Execution
examples.summary: S809.2 was a 9-agent read-only assessment that expanded S809.1's findings. It discovered 53 empty DL-025/DL-026 EW slots (not 45), CorrectChoice discrepancies between Agents C and D on 5 of 38 seeds, 9 DL-013 boilerplate slots across Pack D items, and identified that zero seeds had full distractor EW coverage. The session produced a 4-wave remediation plan with C/D-E parallel authorization, learner-safety screen (0 exposure — all Unprocessed), and 3-scenario completion model. Despite the intelligence depth, execution was impossible — recommendations were report artifacts.

finding.description: Agent C and Agent D disagree on CorrectChoice for 5 of 38 seeds (13.2%): EC-008 (A vs D), EC-014 (C vs B), EC-066 (B vs A), EC-031 (D vs C), EC-072 (D vs C). Root cause unknown — pattern matches DL-016 dual-block architecture despite Agent D's single-object confirmation. Independent third-agent CC audit is mandatory before any EW authoring.

tracing.recommendation_creation: ESCALATION-001 would create REC-S809-005 (P0, CC audit mandate) and REC-S809-006 (P0, DL-010 re-audit on EC-020). The 4-wave plan from Agent H becomes the batch execution plan for REC-S809-002 (DL-026 slot filling).
tracing.session_assignment: CC audit → S810 Step 0. DL-026 EW authoring → S810 Waves 1-4. EC enhancement → S810. CAQS verification → S811. All assigned before any write begins.
tracing.work_execution: Wave 1 (4 foundation items) → Wave 2 (12 core concepts) → Wave 3 (15 control activities) → Wave 4 (7 capstone items). Pack C and D batches execute in parallel within each wave.
tracing.closure_evidence: Post-S810: 0 DL-026 empty slots, 0 DL-013 boilerplate. Post-S811: 38/38 passing CAQS §1.6 at HIGH confidence. Pre-delivery safety check confirms 0 known-defective QIDs in delivery pool.

sample_recommendations.Owner: Independent Third Agent — CC Audit Specialist
sample_recommendations.Description: ESCALATION-001: 5 seeds show cross-agent CorrectChoice disagreement. Pattern matches DL-016 metadata-content block divergence. Must resolve via boundary-aware object extraction (Function constructor parse) using the content-block CC as authoritative. Wrong CC cascades into DL-008 violations. Methodology: identity-engine approach — resolve each QID by extracting its complete JSON object boundary, extracting CC from within that boundary (not forward-scan from prev QID), and comparing Agents C and D reads.

sample_recommendations.Notes: P0 — compound defect on a 'burn-victim' item. Agent E later investigated (S810.1) and concluded no DL-010 existed (confused EC-020 with EC-022). Re-assess under identity-engine resolution.

examples.title: S810.1 → Intelligence Package — All Plans Ready, No Mechanism to Execute
examples.summary: S810.1 was an 11-agent read-only intelligence-gathering session that produced the definitive remediation blueprint for 38 Domain E seeds. It confirmed 53 empty DL-026 slots, 9 DL-013 boilerplate slots, 0 DL-010 (all Agent B claims were false alarms per Agent E), 37/38 seeds lacking COSO citations, 23/38 difficulty overstated, 26/38 CognitiveLevel misaligned, and 38/38 missing AccountingPrinciple fields. Agent J produced a 3-batch execution plan with 83 estimated writes. Agent K forecast 28 READY + 10 MINOR_REVIEW post-S810. Despite having the complete intelligence package, the session produced zero writes — recommendations were thorough but inert.

finding.description: S810.1 confirmed all prior findings and added: COSO citation gap (37/38), systemic difficulty inflation (60.5%), metadata completeness gaps (6 missing fields), and a precise 3-batch execution plan. Batch A (19 items, 24 writes), Batch B (12 items, 32 writes), Batch C (7 items, 27 writes). Zero learner-pool exposure. All seeds technically certifiable — only blocker is content authoring.
finding.severity: Various — P0 to P2 across defect classes

tracing.recommendation_creation: Under Framework v2, S810.1 would not need to re-discover the same findings. REC-S809-001 through REC-S809-006 would already exist in the registry with status ASSIGNED or IN_PROGRESS. S810.1's 11 agents would operate as a verification/remediation execution team rather than an analysis team — their output would be closure evidence, not another report package.
tracing.session_assignment: REC-S809-001 (DL-016) and REC-S809-002 (DL-026) would already be ASSIGNED to S810. REC-S809-005 (CC audit) would be IN_PROGRESS. S810.1's intelligence would populate ClosureEvidence rather than creating new OPEN recommendations.
tracing.work_execution: Agent J's 3-batch plan becomes the execution roadmap. Batch A (19 items, EW fills + EC enrichment) → Batch B (12 items, dual-slot fills) → Batch C (7 items, DL-013 replacement + EC rewrites). Parallel Pack C/D sub-batches within each batch. Governance checkpoints at Tmid.
tracing.closure_evidence: Post-Batch C: 0 DL-026 empty slots, 0 DL-013 boilerplate, 0 DL-008 regression. Agent K's readiness forecast: 28 READY (S810 certification), 10 MINOR_REVIEW (S811 QA). Closure evidence includes per-QID spot-check attestations, COSO citation verification, difficulty recalibration, and governance guard suite pass.

strategic_outcome.summary: The Recommendation Pipeline prevents the S809 chain (4 sessions, 60+ agents, 0 writes) from recurring. S809.1 would create REC-S809-001 through REC-S809-004. S809.2 would add REC-S809-005 through REC-S809-006. These 6 open recommendations would create visible backlogs that route directly to execution. S810 would not re-discover the same findings — it would pick up ASSIGNED recommendations and move them to IN_PROGRESS. The result: 1 analysis session (S809.1) → recommendation registry → 1 execution session (S810) → 1 verification session (S811) → CLOSED. 4 sessions → 3 sessions, 60+ agents → ~15 agents, 0 writes → 83 writes.
